tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm, brown-tinted neutral.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on surface-100: cards, inputs, table bodies.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Inset and hover surfaces: code blocks, table headers, hovered rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of interactive controls (inputs, secondary buttons). At least 3:1 on surface-100 and surface-200 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and labels on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single accent (teal). Primary button fill, links, focus ring, selected state. Text on surface-100, 200 and 300.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill. Dark on the light teal, white on the dark teal.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for selected rows and the Note callout. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Earthy secondary tone. Decorative only (cover, charts, slides); never carries state or text.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Success text and marks on surface-100, 200 and 300. Always paired with the word Done or Ok.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text and marks on surface-100, 200 and 300. Always paired with the word Check.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Error text and marks on surface-100, 200 and 300. Always paired with the word Blocked or Error.

tokens.name: good-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground of the Done callout. Text on it is ink; title in good.

tokens.name: warn-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground of the Check callout. Text on it is ink; title in warn.

tokens.name: critical-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground of the Blocked callout. Text on it is ink; title in critical.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Controls, table cells, dense tool UI.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase captions, table headers, tag text.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, commands, paths, ids, tabular data. Use tabular numerals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Control gaps, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards and groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page section separation.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top and bottom page padding on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Tables, full-bleed bands, dividers.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small marks: tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Boxes and controls: buttons, inputs, cards, callouts, cover blocks. Visible, never bubbly.
